newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank of America gets NBP bank licence okay.
newsitem.headline: Bank of America gets NBP bank licence okay.

text.p: Bank of America has received initial approval from the National Bank of Poland for a banking licence to create a Polish branch, central bank's spokeswoman Renata Wisniewska said on Wednesday.
The bank still needed final approval from the finance ministry, Wisniewska told Reuters.
"The president of the National Bank of Poland has initially approved the application for the licence. It now goes to the finance ministry for their signature," she said.
The finance ministry had no immediate comment on the licence.
